title: Website Cost Calculator & Price Estimator – Free Web Design
description: Free interactive website cost calculator and price estimator. Calculate estimated budgets for custom web design, WordPress, e-commerce, and SEO services.
estimateDesc: Approximate range based on market rates

how.title: How the Website Cost Calculator Works
paragraphs: The calculator estimates project cost from two inputs you control: page count and the feature set your site needs. Each additional page adds design, build, and content-layout effort, while toggles for multilingual support, SEO foundations, speed optimization, and security reflect the work that goes into production-grade builds.

Estimates are based on current market rates for agency-quality custom websites — not template reseller pricing. Treat the result as a realistic budgeting range: a final quote depends on content readiness, integrations, and the complexity of your design direction.

useCases.title: When to Use This Calculator
items: Budgeting a new website before you request proposals, so vendor quotes are comparable.
Sanity-checking an received quote against transparent, market-rate line items.
Scoping a minimum viable launch: see exactly which features move the price and decide what can ship in phase two.
